title: Sync Shapes Across Slides (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Sync Shapes Across Slides applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Sync Shapes Across Slides (BtnSyncObjects) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Sync Objects window opens in real PowerPoint and reports its window state
Owner retake of Sync Shapes Across Slides header movement after the caption fix
scenarios.expected: In real PowerPoint, dragging the upper Sync Shapes Across Slides title region changes the window position; exactly one resize grip shows in the bottom-right corner, and Close/Cancel work normally.
ownerSteps: Open Sync Shapes Across Slides in PowerPoint and drag its upper title region; confirm that the window position changes.
Confirm only one resize triangle shows in the bottom-right corner and that resizing still works.
Check the Close button and reopen the workspace.
scenarios.technicalReason: Deterministic automation verifies the native non-client routing only (WM_NCHITTEST: Title/TopPadding return HTCAPTION, Close/Body return HTCLIENT) plus the single-grip visual tree count in eng/Smoke-SyncObjectsWindow.ps1. Physical movement under a real pointer gesture follows the Map Builder precedent (REG-MAP-BUILDER-DRAG-001): one synthetic fixture gesture produced zero movement and a further attempt refused input because the fixture shell was not opaque, so no synthetic pointer input is injected and movement must be observed interactively by the owner.

scenarios.title: Sync Shapes Across Slides keeps one resize grip and routes its header to native dragging
scenarios.expected: The actual compiled Sync Shapes Across Slides window contains exactly one resize grip (the workspace corner grip; the former footer grip that produced the duplicated triangle is gone) and routes its full measured header region to native HTCAPTION while Close and the body stay HTCLIENT.
